newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends easier vs dlr on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends easier vs dlr on quiet market.

text.p: Hungary's forint finished a shade weaker against the dollar on Tuesday in light turnover, dealers said.
The forint's finished at 160.05/10, compared to an opening of 159.82/88, reflecting an afternoon strengthening of the dollar/mark.
The central bank resistance level stood at 159.88 at the close.
Orsolya Liptai of Magyar Hitel Bank said the current lacklustre pre-Christmas trade could kick into life on Wednesday.
"I see tomorrow as the last day before Christmas where there might be some activity as some maturities expire on the Budapest Commodities Exchange (BCE) futures market," she said.
The BCE currency futures market saw another heavy day, with the Swiss franc, lira and mark sharing most of the 12.4 billion forints of turnover.
All three ended mixed while the dollar dropped.
